reviews.review_description: I expected kinda low of this game but it’s way better than I thought. My friends and I were playing and had lots of fun, I would 100% recommend this game if like horror and scariness😁😁❤️

This game is really good and me and my friends had a great time playing. But we would like it better if it had a shop.
